# Market Game (Рыночек Порешает)

> A team business simulation where crews compete for one shared market
> over 12, 24 or 36 game months, all played in a single session. Built both
> for people about to start a business and for owners already running one,
> who would rather make their expensive mistakes on a game board than with
> their own money.

Run by Nikolay Bulenkov. Available online and offline, in Russian and English.

## What it is

Several teams sit down around a single market and compete for the same
10,000 customers. Each turn is one game month, three to five minutes long.
Every team sets a price, invests in quality, picks advertising channels,
adds tables, hires staff and takes loans. A model — not a host —
then distributes the customers according to how attractive each team's
combination of price, quality, advertising and capacity looks.

Each team gets a monthly report: revenue, costs, profit, cash on hand and
market share. At the end of the game, whoever holds the most cash wins.

The setting is a food court, but the mechanics are industry-agnostic:
limited demand, competitors fighting for the same people, price against
quality, advertising that may not pay off, capacity constrained by money,
and a cash gap that arrives before the profit does.

There is no briefing before the game — learning the rules while playing is
deliberate, and mirrors how opening a real business actually feels.

## Pricing

Prices are per team, not per person. A team may have any number of people.
A single game seats 4 to 20 teams.

- League 12 · Start — 25 USD / 2,000 RUB / 650,000 VND per team. 12 game
  months. For people who have no business yet and want to learn the cost of
  typical mistakes first.
- League 24 · Growth — 100 USD / 8,500 RUB / 2,600,000 VND per team. 24 game
  months. For owners of a running business with up to 10 employees and up to
  1,000,000 USD annual revenue.
- League 36 · Elite — 3000 USD / 250,000 RUB / 78,000,000 VND per team.
  36 game months. A strategy session for medium and large businesses, with an
  extended debrief for the owner.

The leagues differ in exactly two ways: how long the game runs, and who else
is at the table. The market model itself is identical in every league and is
not customised per industry.

Important: the 12, 24 and 36 are GAME months, not calendar months. The whole
game is played in one session; one game month is one turn of three to five
minutes.

Payment is arranged directly with a manager after a request is submitted
through the site. There is no online checkout.

## Why a live game rather than an AI consultant

On a real market you compete against people, not against models. An AI will
give you a competent, lawful, entirely standard strategy — and that is
precisely what competitors do not do. They dig in, bluff, cut prices out of
spite, copy you two months too late, or make a move no calculation would
propose. It is the difference between playing chess against an engine and
against a human being.

The mistake the game exposes: you can build a flawless company — calculated
price, honest quality, advertising in the right channels, capacity sized to
demand — and still lose, because the competitor beside you behaved in a way
your model never allowed for. What decides the fate of a business is not how
the company is arranged internally, but what happens between you and the next
table. Sitting down against more experienced opponents is the fastest way to
see it.

## What people use it for

- Training: skills practised through action rather than lecture notes.
- Assessment: one game shows how a person does the maths, decides on
  incomplete data and handles being overtaken.
- Diagnostics: managerial habits surface within the first few turns.
- Practice: the same model can be replayed with a different strategy.

## Author

Nikolay Vladimirovich Bulenkov. Over twenty years in sales, management and
business development. Created "Deal Simulator" in 2014, named the most
useful training tool for realtors in Russia that year by MAUA. Sales
director at Like Centre 2017–2019; head of the training centre of the
"33 Slona" project within Mail.ru Group 2019–2021. Graduate of Bauman
Moscow State Technical University.

## Contact

Requests are submitted through the form on any language version of the site.

## Phuket Business League

An offline community of entrepreneurs on Phuket, modeled on American chambers
of commerce. Members meet 2–6 times a month: business games, workshops, guest
talks, business breakfasts and evening mixers. Meetings are open, with no
prepayment; games run in two leagues and are paid per team at the meeting:
League 12 — 850 THB ($25), League 24 — 3,350 THB ($100). A meeting needs at
least four participants. The venue address is sent personally after sign-up.
Pages in English and Russian: https://marketgame.club/phuket/
